wishes.help: Each time someone has a birthday, the bot sends one wish from this list. A wish is sent only once per round; when all of them have been sent, a new round starts. {placeholder} is where the bot mentions (@) the person whose birthday it is.

empty.body: While the list is empty, the bot picks one of its built-in wishes at random. Add your own wishes for the bot to use instead.
